changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6a item 4: deleted TeammateRuntimeOwnerCallbacks, the function-valued dependency bag RuntimeGeneration used to reach back into AgentService's private phase field via isActive()/markClosing(). RuntimeGeneration.ensureStarted() now takes no phase callback and simply resolves once the runtime is live or throws; it no longer self-aborts mid-launch. AgentService now owns the race check itself through one new private method, ensureRuntimeStarted(), used by every one of its three callers of runtimeGeneration.ensureStarted() (admitToRuntime, activate(), the locked Workflow submit path): it checks this.phase itself before calling ensureStarted() (replacing the old pre-lease isActive() check) and again immediately after ensureStarted() resolves, stopping the runtime and reporting not-active itself when a close raced and won the awaited start (replacing the old post-start isActive() self-abort). The one case that used to call markClosing() — startFromRecord's rollback branch where the rollback's own runtime.stop() also fails after a native start failure — now has RuntimeGeneration throw a new named error, RuntimeTerminationUnproven (an AggregateError subclass carrying the same start/stop failure pair), which ensureRuntimeStarted() catches to set AgentService's own phase to 'closing' before rethrowing; this is the mutation every caller previously got for free via the callback, so centralizing it is what keeps a runtime whose termination could not be proven from being handed out by a later ensureStarted() call, which treats any non-null runtime handle as already live and never re-examines it. Internal control-flow refactor moving which class owns a phase decision. One caller-visible admission-outcome shape changed for the narrow start-races-close window: a submission that used to reject with an 'is closing' Error now resolves as an ordinary {status:'stopped'} TurnAdmission (the same shape a submission to an already-stopped recipient always gets), so its display reason becomes 'the agent runtime is not running' instead of the old message text. The issue #63 non-blocking submit ordering (runtime.submit fires synchronously before being handed to the admission continuation queue) is untouched.
